scope: Fixed supplied models and observations; no retraining or resampling.
known_sensitivity: Other runs returned different 5% orders, including the manuscript values alpha=0.7461027702250187 and beta=1.7567659083262153. Passing these three process repetitions does not establish parameter invariance across call histories or environments.
rejected_change: Two score-tolerance/tie-handling variants gave repeatable but incorrect structures and were not incorporated. The historical threshold-search algorithm remains unchanged.
